title: CLI studio in the main area, aligned with the backend, and continued in cmd
user_story: As the owner I want the CLI chat to look like a chat (prompt at the bottom, framed transcript and answers), to use the CLI tool I pick, and to continue the same conversation in a Windows cmd console.

requirements.description: POST /api/chat/sessions/{sid}/console opens phdlab chat --session <sid> in a new console (cmd.exe on Windows, x-terminal-emulator elsewhere) on the loopback port the server socket listens on, and returns the command to reopen it.
Only PhD Lab's own client starts with a fixed argument list; invalid or unknown session ids and invalid ports start nothing; API keys are not passed to the console.
Without a terminal launcher the command is still returned so the researcher can run it.

nonfunctional: UI acceptance (frontend CI): frontend/src/features/cli/ClaudeCLIStudio.test.tsx (main-area entry, framed transcript and answers, prompt last, providers from /api/models, provider sent and saved on the conversation, manual launch, inline errors, per-item approvals, language, reload, Open in cmd) and frontend/e2e/cli_studio.spec.ts (4 viewports x 2 languages x 2 themes, 100 messages, suggestions; overlap, occlusion, clipping, sideways scroll, title truncation); frontend/e2e/shell_layout.spec.ts (sidebar at 1024/1280/1440 px in both languages, Right-menu handle over chat, library, harness, review, dashboard, settings and CLI)
Opening a console never waits for it
outputs: turn with provider override and conversation provider
preconditions: Windows cmd.exe or an x-terminal-emulator for automatic opening
postconditions: Browser and console share one conversation and its provider
acceptance_criteria: Prompt is the bottom block at every tested viewport; transcript and answers are framed
The selected CLI provider is the one the turn and the conversation use
Open in cmd continues the same conversation in a real cmd console (live, 2026-10-28)
No overlap, occlusion, clipping or sideways scroll in the tested matrix

scenarios.expected: cmd.exe /d /k with the session, PHDLAB_URL on the listening port, new console
The route passes the socket's port
The same command line runs in a real cmd.exe
Injection-shaped, traversal and unknown ids, and port 0, start nothing
OPENAI_API_KEY is not in the console environment
launched false with the command to run
Returns in under 0.5 s and never waits for the console

recovery: Fix the launcher, never widen what it may start. TASK-CLI-STUDIO-663, max three cycles.
test_environment: Real session store, API route and cmd.exe with a disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR; process creation mocked except the real cmd.exe quoting run. UI evidence in docs/qa/evidence/cli-studio-663/ (vitest, Playwright, live run with the owner's Codex and Claude Code).
